stage1.impression: A terraced glowing ball on a dark table at night, with a quiet, believable mood, but the body is one flat blown red-pink mass in which the thirteen rings run together, and the black base and the left prop sink into black. It reads as an emissive blob in a dim box rather than lit amber acrylic in a dusk room.

blocking_9: The lamp body must not clip: the red channel is at 255 over 100% of the core [520,330,680,460] and 88.7% of [450,300,750,500].
The colour has to read as amber light through acrylic, not as clipped pink-red (r 255, g 151, b 139 now).
The black anodised base must have form: it is 91.6% crushed with median 0 in [450,580,750,650].
The wall is one value (median 13.9, range 2.0 over [50,50,350,300]).
The table has to show the lamp's coloured pool clearly, falling off from the base outwards.
The left prop is a featureless slab (top 22.7 with range 5.8, front 2.7 and 72% crushed).

changes.problem: The body is clipped and flat, so the terraces merge into one red blob and the hue shifts to pink.
changes.expected: Each ring's lip separates; clip under 3%.

changes.problem: The black anodised base and the knob are crushed to pure black.
changes.expected: Base median about 8 to 30, crush under 40%.

changes.problem: The fill is the same warm colour as the lamp.

evidence.measured: wall r 20, g 14, b 15, flat at 15.3

changes.expected: A cool dusk cast on the wall.

changes.problem: The wall is one flat value with no gradient.
The table is a dark, low-albedo veneer.
changes.expected: The pool reads clearly with grain.

changes.problem: The left prop is an untextured slab.

change.to: two stacked books with visible spines plus a small plate with two pears, set back-left

changes.problem: After the exposure cut, the lamp's throw may be too weak.
changes.expected: The pool holds 15 to 35 while the body stays unclipped.

out_of_scope.why: The tint is fixed and calibrated.

out_of_scope.request: Remove the vertical seams visible on several rings (around x 470 and x 760).
out_of_scope.why: They look like tessellation facets; geometry is fixed.

duel.why: A reads more like a photograph ... B is the more distinctive object, a stacked-ring lantern, but the rings look like stepped CG primitives with faceted seams, the base and cable stub are crude, and the near-black backdrop makes the light do little beyond the shade itself.
